info.title: ManishaPay API
info.description: One payments API for many gateways. Integrate once with ManishaPay and accept payments across PayNow, Stripe, Paystack, Flutterwave, PayPal, M-Pesa (Daraja), PayFast and more — pick the gateway with the `provider` field; the response shape is the same for all. Built by Noby Tebulo. Import this spec into Postman, Insomnia or Swagger UI to explore.

tags.name: Checkout
tags.description: No-code hosted checkout links with multi-method routing

tags.name: Refunds
tags.description: Record refunds (funds moved by the underlying gateway)

post.description: Creates a payment on the chosen gateway (set `provider`, defaults to PayNow) and returns a browser_url to send the customer to. The response shape is identical across gateways. Send an Idempotency-Key header to make retries safe (a repeat with the same key returns the original response, never a second charge).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Unique key per payment attempt to prevent duplicate charges on retry.

403.description: Developer suspended, IP not allowed, or read-only key

get.description: Returns the current status of a payment by your merchant reference. Polls the gateway live where possible.

post.description: Marks a paid transaction as refunded and notifies your webhooks. ManishaPay orchestrates — the actual funds movement is completed by the underlying gateway under your own gateway account.

amount.description: Partial refund amount; defaults to full.

400.description: Transaction is not in a refundable (paid) state

post.description: Creates a shareable no-code checkout at /pay/{slug}. Set `enabled_methods` to offer the customer a multi-method chooser — each method they pick is routed to a gateway you've connected (explicit override → primary provider → catalog order). Omit it to offer the primary provider's own methods. Uses your dashboard session (JWT).

400.description: Invalid payload or unknown method name

get.description: Public — no API key. Returns the link's amount and the methods the customer can pay with right now (offered methods that have a connected gateway to fulfil them). Use it to build your own checkout UI, or just send the customer to the hosted page at /pay/{slug}.

post.summary: Start a payment for a hosted checkout
post.description: Public — no API key. Pass the `method` the customer chose (from GET /v1/links/{slug} → methods[].method); ManishaPay routes it to the connected gateway that serves it and returns a browser_url — or, for phone-push rails, a pending status with the prompt already on the customer's phone. Omit `method` to use the checkout's primary provider.

400.description: No connected gateway can process the chosen method

ApiKey.description: Your ManishaPay API key as a Bearer token.

provider.description: Which gateway processes the payment: paynow | stripe | paystack | flutterwave | paypal | mpesa | payfast. Defaults to paynow. Coming soon: yoco, pesepay, ozow, dpo.

amount.description: Amount; normalised to two decimals server-side.

email.description: Customer email (used as authemail for Express Checkout).

phone.description: Customer mobile; normalised to +263 form so OTPs fire.

method.description: Payment rail — depends on the provider (e.g. PayNow: ecocash, onemoney, innbucks, omari, zimswitch, card; M-Pesa: mpesa; Stripe/PayPal: card). Omit for a hosted redirect / all methods.

provider.description: The gateway that processed this payment.

browser_url.description: Send the customer here to pay.

status_normalized.description: Canonical status — same values across all gateways.

qr_code.description: Data-URI QR of the checkout URL.

provider.description: Primary gateway for the checkout. Wins the routing tie-break when several connected gateways serve a chosen method.

enabled_methods.description: Methods to offer the customer, e.g. ["ecocash","card"]. Omit to offer the primary provider's own methods. Each method is routed to a connected gateway at pay time.

method_routing.description: Optional override pinning a method to a specific gateway, e.g. {"card":"stripe"}.

method.description: Rail id — pass this back to POST /v1/links/{slug}/pay.

needsPhone.description: Collect a mobile number for this method.

kind.description: Grouping for iconography: mobile | card | bank | wallet | voucher | ussd.

provider.description: The gateway this method routes to.

methods.description: What the customer can pay with right now. Empty → render a single Pay button (legacy single-gateway link).

method.description: The method the customer chose (from HostedCheckout.methods[].method). Omit to use the primary provider.

phone.description: Required for mobile-money methods where needsPhone is true.

resolution.description: A human, actionable explanation of how to fix it.
